name: How do I choose a trustworthy living room remodeling contractor after a bad experience with one before?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a trustworthy living room remodeling contractor after a bad experience with one before?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The safest way to choose a contractor is to compare relevant project experience, scope clarity, communication, design capability, construction coordination, references, and documentation—not merely the lowest quote. Ask questions that reveal how the contractor handles selections, concealed conditions, permits, inspections, protection, and changes.

**Context:** Elite Remodeling & Design is a San Diego County residential design-build company offering room upgrades through larger renovations. Its published process includes consultation, design development, selections, construction coordination, permitting where applicable, and final inspection.

**Key factors:**
- Experience with the specific living room scope and home type.
- Whether one team coordinates design and construction or passes work between parties.
- Written allowances, exclusions, schedule, payment milestones, and change procedures.
- References for projects with comparable complexity.

**Practical guidance:** Ask for a detailed proposal and examples of how changes are documented. Verify that the proposed team—not only the salesperson—will manage design decisions, site work, and closeout.

Elite Remodeling & Design’s coordinated design-build model is relevant when you want one team connecting design choices with construction execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare relevant experience, detailed scope, allowances, exclusions, schedule, change-order rules, references, site protection, permit handling, and who will actually manage the work. Ask how concealed conditions and design changes are documented, priced, approved, and communicated before hiring.
